what: When the cursor is swung near stickers and photo pieces, the element is nudged within its own width by that frame’s cursor speed, then springs back into place (pull .18 · damping .3 — it barely overshoots and settles fast). If the cursor has been still for 100ms, nothing is pushed. Only translate is used, so the element’s rotate and transform stay as they are

options.pull: Pull strength back into place (0–1), default .18
options.damp: Leftover speed ratio per frame (0~1), default .3 — larger means a longer wobble
options.reach: Distance the cursor pushes (times element width), default 1

note: Don’t attach on devices without hover interaction (touch)
